# ImpressionistArts

> > A comprehensive resource on Impressionist and Post-Impressionist art, featuring biographies of masters like Monet, Manet, Degas, and van Gogh, along with artwork analysis and 19th-century Parisian art culture.

ImpressionistArts explores the Impressionist movement through detailed artist biographies, painting analyses, exhibition histories, and the social context of 19th-century Paris. The site covers major figures from Claude Monet and Edouard Manet to Post-Impressionists like van Gogh and Gauguin, examining their techniques, lives, and cultural impact.

## Key Topics

- Claude Monet
- Edouard Manet
- Edgar Degas
- Camille Pissarro
- Pierre-Auguste Renoir
- Vincent van Gogh
- Paul Gauguin
- 19th-century Paris
- Impressionism movement
- Post-Impressionism
- Pointillism
- French art history
- Impressionist exhibitions
- Musée d'Orsay
- Parisian cafe culture

## Essential Impressionist History

- [First Impressionist Exhibition](https://impressionistarts.com/first-impressionist-exhibition): History of 1874 First Impressionist Exhibition on Rue du Capucines Paris
- [Claude Monet's Impression Sunrise](https://impressionistarts.com/claude-monet-impression-sunrise): Analysis of Monet's Impression Sunrise (1872) painted at Le Havre port
- [Edouard Manet's Olympia](https://impressionistarts.com/edouard-manet-olympia): Analysis of Manet's controversial Olympia (1863) at Musee d'Orsay Paris
- [Eighth & Final Impressionist Exhibition](https://impressionistarts.com/eighth-impressionist-exhibition): 1886 final impressionist exhibition with Morisot, Pissarro, and Cassatt
- [Sixth Impressionist Exhibition](https://impressionistarts.com/sixth-impressionist-exhibition): 1881 sixth exhibition marked by Degas-Caillebotte conflicts and divisions
- [Musee d'Orsay, Paris](https://impressionistarts.com/musee-dorsay-paris): Guide to Musee d'Orsay's impressionist collection featuring Manet and Monet

## Artist Biographies

- [Henri Toulouse-Lautrec](https://impressionistarts.com/henri-toulouse-lautrec-biography): Biography of Henri Toulouse-Lautrec and Parisian Montmartre nightlife art
- [Pablo Picasso](https://impressionistarts.com/pablo-picasso-biography): Biography of Pablo Picasso from Malaga to Barcelona and Blue Period
- [Gustave Caillebotte](https://impressionistarts.com/gustave-caillebotte-biography): Biography of Gustave Caillebotte: painter, patron, and art collector
- [Emile Zola](https://impressionistarts.com/emile-zola-biography): Biography of influential French writer Emile Zola from Aix-en-Provence

## Artist Timelines

- [Timeline of Frederic Bazille's Life](https://impressionistarts.com/frederic-bazille-timeline): Chronological timeline of Frederic Bazille's life and impressionist career
- [Timeline of Alfred Sisley's life](https://impressionistarts.com/timeline-alfred-sisley-life): Chronological timeline of British impressionist Alfred Sisley's life events

## Top Paintings Collections

- [Top 10 Camille Pissarro Paintings](https://impressionistarts.com/top-10-camille-pissarro-paintings): Camille Pissarro's top 10 impressionist and neo-impressionist paintings
- [Top 10 Signac Paintings](https://impressionistarts.com/top-10-signac-paintings): Paul Signac's top 10 neo-impressionist and pointillist masterpieces
- [Top 10 Paintings of All Time](https://impressionistarts.com/top-10-paintings-of-all-time): World's top 10 paintings including da Vinci's Mona Lisa at the Louvre

## Art Movement Analysis

- [Was van Gogh an Impressionist?](https://impressionistarts.com/was-van-gogh-an-impressionist): Analysis of van Gogh's relationship to impressionism vs post-impressionism
- [Is it OK to like Gauguin's Art?](https://impressionistarts.com/is-it-okay-to-like-gauguins-art): Exploring the ethics of appreciating Paul Gauguin's art despite controversy

## 19th-Century Paris Social Context

- [Impressionism and Paris Cafes](https://impressionistarts.com/impressionism-cafes-paris): 19th century Paris cafe culture and impressionist art by Manet and others
- [Impressionism and Prostitution](https://impressionistarts.com/impressionism-and-prostitution): 19th century Paris prostitution as subject in impressionist art and culture
